name: TCL 55S470G
summary: Tidy a TCL 55S470G by turning off its Samba TV tracker, TCL ads and promos, demo modes and preloaded apps. Free phone app with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: The TCL 55S470G comes with a Samba TV viewing tracker, TCL usage logging and account sign-in prompts, content and promos pushed to the home screen, a silent app installer, retail demo and hotel mode apps, and preloaded apps such as Alexa. Much of it is for tracking or promotion rather than for watching TV.

The notes come from one TCL 55S470G, which shipped with its tracking services switched on. Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Disney+, Apple TV, Paramount+, Tubi, TCL TV+ and TCL Live are kept, as are AirPlay and firmware updates. TidyTV turns these apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi with a backup first, and nothing is uninstalled.
keep: Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Disney+, Apple TV, Paramount+ and Tubi
TCL TV+ and TCL Live channels
TCL's Live TV and HDMI inputs
Firmware updates, which run through a TCL service that also does Samba TV work
notes: Samba TV also has to be switched off in the TV's own settings. Open Settings, Privacy, Samba Interactive TV, and untick every provider, since the main switch leaves them on.
The TCL service that runs Samba TV is kept, because it also handles firmware updates. Turn it off only if you are happy to skip those updates.

faq.a: AirPlay is kept, but Chromecast built-in is off by choice in this list. Turn it back on in the app if you cast often.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work?
faq.a: Not as this list stands. Google Assistant and Alexa are turned off by choice, so turn them back on in the app if you use voice.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: It turns off TCL's pushed home screen content, its partner tweaks to the home rows and its message box promos. Google's own recommendation rows are not on this list.
